title: FieldMaps subnational — searchable names index
description: ILLUSTRATIVE, NOT PUBLISHED. What adopting the `gazetteer` extension alone would look like for an existing catalog: one sorted names parquet beside boundary files that already exist, with no change to those files and no simplified variant required. Row counts and column names are taken from the real published fieldmaps/subnational/global layers (2026-11-17); the index asset itself is hypothetical. Place-name/boundary lookup, not address geocoding.
